# Curved CAD reference fixtures

Generated by `paacs-primitive-cad-reference --fixtures DIRECTORY` using
Open CASCADE. Fifteen shapes each have STEP and BREP versions. They are used
to compare explicitly parameterized meshes against an independent CAD kernel:
volume, boundary-point/facet-center distances and cell-center classification.

These files do not extend `importPlanarCad` or imply automatic curved CAD
recognition. See `docs/PRIMITIVES.md` for the supported meshing API and scope.
The [asset provenance](../../../docs/ASSET_PROVENANCE.md) records how the
regenerated files were compared with the checked-in copies.
